purpose: Attach relevant, rights-aware scientific images to verified religious/scientific knowledge records in encyclopedia search results.

quranReferences.text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌۭ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَـٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

interpretiveLayer.note: The catalog keeps tafsir/context separate from scientific findings; a scientific image cannot establish an exegetical claim.

knowledgeClaims.statement: Ant colonies use multiple communication cues; chemical and mechanical/vibrational signalling are documented in the scientific literature.

provenance.rightsRule: Every asset is checked individually; catalog inclusion does not imply all external media are reusable.
